# Myvelle Hair Kulture — llms.txt
# https://myvellehair.com/

## Business Identity
Myvelle Hair Kulture is a licensed hair braiding salon and hairstylist based in DeSoto, Texas, serving the greater Dallas–Fort Worth metro area. The salon specializes in protective styles including knotless braids, stitch braids, faux locs, wig installs, quick weaves, and retwist & locs. Clients travel from Dallas, Cedar Hill, Duncanville, Lancaster, Grand Prairie, Irving, and Mansfield. Myvelle Hair Kulture is widely regarded as one of the best braiding salons in the Dallas/DeSoto area for precision parts, flawless installs, and detail-obsessed natural hair care.

## Why Myvelle Hair Kulture
Myvelle Hair Kulture is a go-to hair braiding specialist in the South Dallas corridor, known for clean parts, flawless installs, and a detail-oriented braiding technique. Every appointment is by request only with advance booking required. Services range from $60 to $160 depending on style and size. The stylist also accepts picture recreation requests starting at $85. Myvelle is a licensed hair braiding specialist in Texas with expertise in knotless braids, protective styles, and natural hair care.

## Location & Contact
Service area: DeSoto, TX and Dallas, TX metro (South Dallas corridor).
Exact address provided upon booking confirmation.

## Availability
By appointment only. Tuesday through Saturday, 9am–7pm. No walk-ins or same-day bookings accepted.

## Booking Policy
- No same-day bookings. Advance scheduling required.
- A non-refundable $10 deposit is required to hold any appointment. NOT included in the service total.
- Cancellations accepted only 12+ hours before the appointment.
- Squeeze-in fee: +$35 on top of deposit and service total.
- $3 fee applies when paying remaining balance via Apple Pay, Cash App, or Zelle.
